$about: CTL-2300 Tier 2 — THE ONE FILE ALLOWED TO SPELL A TENANT-SHAPED LITERAL.
Every value below is a CANONICAL DEFAULT: what a Catalyst tenant gets when it has declared
nothing of its own. It is not a description of any tenant's board, and a tool must never treat
over every rung of it, and the GET /api/v1/agent/contract route will win over both once it
exists (the CTC half of this pair).
It exists so the deny-list scan in lib/board-vocabulary.test.mjs has an ALLOWED SOURCE to point
at. The scan forbids these strings in argument position anywhere in the shipped surface — every
skill .md and every non-test script under plugins/dev — so the only way to reach one is to
resolve it, and the only place it is written down is here. A literal re-added three modules over
reddens the suite instead of shipping as somebody else's stage name.
⛔ knownTeamKeys is OUR fleet's teams, listed here PRECISELY SO THEY CAN BE FORBIDDEN. It is not
an allowlist a tool may filter on and it must never be read as one — a customer's team key is
not in it and never will be.
